items.title: Lam Research’s Etch Moat Could Become the Most Profitable Lever in Next‑Gen Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.summary: Lam Research just clawed back 34% from a brutal selloff, and a $3 billion R&D commitment to next-gen etching technology suggests the rebound may only be the beginning. But whether the company can own the atomic layer etching era before a supercycle hits is the question every semiconductor investor should be asking right now.

items.title: Applied Materials is Down 6% Premarket. Will It Drag Down Lam Research, KLA, and Other Semi Equipment Stocks?
items.summary: Applied Materials just dropped 6% premarket despite posting record revenue and guiding for 51% growth, and the reason comes down to a two-week rally that left almost no room for anything short of perfect. Whether peers like Lam Research and KLA get dragged down with it tells you everything about where the semiconductor equipment trade stands right now.

items.title: Applied Materials slips as investors seek faster growth after stellar run
items.summary: Applied Materials shares fell about 4% in early trading on Friday, as ‌the chip equipment maker's upbeat outlook failed to soothe ‌investors worried about the threat from intensifying competition.  The muted reaction illustrates the ​high bar chip stocks have to clear and suggests that investors have little tolerance for any hint that a company may be falling behind peers.  After a sharp rally that has more ‌than doubled Applied's ⁠shares this year, investors want clearer signals that the company's growth is outpacing rivals in the ⁠wafer-fab-equipment market.

items.title: Why Lam Research (LRCX) Is Up 10.2% After $3 Billion Global R&D Lab Expansion Plan
items.summary: In August 2026, Lam Research announced plans to invest more than US$3.00 billion over five years to expand its global R&D lab network, aiming to lift experiment capacity by over 50% and compress product development cycles for semiconductor customers across the US, Asia, and Europe. An interesting angle is how this integrated 24/7 lab system, which already supports over one million experiments annually, is being scaled to accelerate AI-era chip innovation through faster, closer collaboration...
